notes:
Planner and Clock are live: your day, tasks, calendar, alarms and rings in one place.

- Planner opens on your day with tasks, events, habits and a catch-up deck; Calendar opens on three days on phones.
- Clock has alarms, timers, stopwatch, a world clock and a full-screen ring with snooze and dismiss.
- Alarms ring on the phone through a new foreground service and on the Desktop; the Hub schedules them.
- Link your Google account from Settings, Connections, Google to sync calendar and tasks.
- Setup lists the battery and full-screen alarm steps your phone still needs.
- The move ring on Fitness and the Planner widgets on Home use your live data.
- Install the new Android app once so the alarm service and Planner module are available.
